prompt_spec: Six-square-floor-tile set in order: intact, frosted, cracked, shattered, edge-transition, corner-transition glass maze floor slabs. Top is a square top face preserving glass pattern; bottom is a solid opaque substrate underside viewed upward with no top pattern; front and rear are thin vertical front/back slab edges; right and left are thin horizontal side-edge profiles. Edge/corner transition shape must remain visible in the top view with coherent thin slab edges.
